Version 0.5.0 · ZIP · Local preview · Python 3.10+

A small install. A head start.

  1. Extract the ZIP into a permanent folder.

    Keep its hidden .agents folder. You need Codex with plugin support and Python available as python3. The supported client check targets Codex 0.154.0 on macOS; Linux and Windows remain unverified.

  2. Open a terminal in the extracted folder.

    If you already have a marketplace named personal, resolve that name conflict first; keep your existing marketplace intact. The archive README includes update and removal steps.

    codex plugin marketplace add .
codex plugin add headstart-plugin@personal
  3. Start a new Codex thread.

    Try: “Use HeadStart to find three starting points for a cozy browser game with farming, exploration and building.” The client must acknowledge the plugin and return a compatible catalog response before you call it connected.

Nine skills. One continuous brief.

Find · Inspect · Plan · Integrate · Validate · Credit, plus Three.js Starter, Unity and Blender guidance. Default discovery searches 52 research references and 105 source-inspected building blocks offline. These are research starting points, not tested integrations.

Bring your selected system along.

The optional localhost connection carries your prepared system versions, brief and constraints into Codex automatically. It requires a separate HeadStart source checkout running locally. Production website pairing and real verification-email delivery are not available in this preview.

  1. Prepare an eligible system on the local website.

    Browse reviewed systems, enter your intent and choose “Prepare agent handoff.” The local verification preview preserves your selection.

  2. Approve the local client in your browser.

    Follow references/connected-setup.md inside the plugin for the source-checkout pairing command and client configuration. Keep verification links and credential contents out of agent prompts.

  3. Ask HeadStart for your prepared selection.

    It retrieves the latest prepared eligible scoped selection for your verified local account. Anonymous research-game bags stay in this browser. Preparing a packet does not start an agent, copy code or change your game.

Local sign-in

Manual setup. This page cannot inspect or confirm your Codex installation.

Another client, or trouble connecting?

If the local service is offline, restart it and retry. A failed live connection never substitutes the bundled research snapshot. Remove the connection settings and start a new thread to deliberately return to offline discovery.

For an unsupported client, prepare an eligible system handoff on the local website, then use its authenticated Download Markdown or Download JSON buttons. Each download rechecks your session and scope rights. The bag's anonymous Gauntlet planning prompt remains available for public references; it does not authorize source reuse or connect an agent.

If local workspace access is denied, keep the plan and choose the intended accessible workspace. An unsupported contract requires compatible plugin/service versions. Do not mix files between releases.
